annotations.title: Property · Parcels by mesh block — lot sizes and shapes within 1 km (by gnaf_id) (beta)

description:
**Beta.** The figures behind this topic have not been validated against an independent source, so it is not sold at the same confidence as the other mesh-block topics. Every response says `beta: true` and carries a `beta_notice`.

**How big are the blocks of land?** For every mesh block around the property: median and spread of lot sizes, lot shape, floor space ratio, the minimum lot size under the planning rules, and the number of land parcels.

One entry per mesh block within 1,000 m of the property under `mesh_blocks`, nearest first, each with its `mb_code`, `distance_m`, `population` and `dwellings`. Blocks across suburb lines are included. Values only — the polygons come from `/properties/{gnaf_id}/context/mesh-blocks`.

Every field carries `provenance` — `measured` (at this block), `measured_wider_area` (measured for the SA1 or postcode and repeated on every block in it), `estimate` (our model) or `not_recorded` (not labelled yet) — plus `how`, one sentence on how the number was arrived at (empty when `not_recorded`).

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
